title: Decoupling language and emotion in the bilingual brain
title_zh: 双语大脑中的语言与情感解耦
abstract: In a recent article, Davydova et al. showed that affect labeling fails in a second, less-proficient language due to the amygdala-ventrolateral prefrontal cortex functional connectivity. This subcortical decoupling also explains the emotional blunting that bilinguals report when using their less-proficient language.
abstract_zh: 最近一篇文章中，Davydova 等人表明，由于杏仁核—外侧腹侧前额叶皮层功能连接，影响标记在第二种不那么熟练的语言中会失败。这种皮层下解耦还解释了双语者使用不那么熟练的语言时报告的情感钝化。
